newsitem.title: PERU: Peru bus crash kills 20, injures 40 - radio.
newsitem.headline: Peru bus crash kills 20, injures 40 - radio.

text.p: Twenty people were killed and 40 injured when two minibuses collided in northern Peru early on Thursday, the local radio station Cadena Peruana De Noticias reported.
The report of the accident near the city of Trujillo, 340 miles (550 km) north of Lima, could not be confirmed immediately.
There has been a rash of major road crashes in Peru, where most people travel on poorly maintained highways in buses that are often overloaded.

Seventeen people were killed and 40 injured in a minibus collision in the north five days ago. Two days earlier, 23 people died and about 50 were injured when a crowded bus overturned on the high plains between the tourist towns of Cusco and Nasca.
